key_facts: PhD C explains that combo is a system where features go through a network, then a low-pass filtered version of the same features goes through another MLP, and the linear outputs of both MLPs are combined by adding the values.
The weighting scheme used for evaluating results is 40% for TI-digit, 60% for all SpeechDat-Cars, with match levels of 40%, 35%, and 25% for well, medium, and high mismatch respectively.
The results for the highly mismatched Italian show some funny behavior, with some results around 36 and others around 42.
The test sets contain between five hundred and two thousand sentences, with each sentence containing between one and sixteen digits.
The second row of the table represents a baseline with OGI features without the combo processing.
The last row of the table represents the second row with combo processing added.

The system is planned to be fixed on Tuesday, with the results to be written up shortly after.

Jeff at the University of Washington has access to a server farm with ten IBM RS 6000 machines, each with four processors, offering significant processing power for scheduling tasks.
